name: Like It's Our Last
source:
A meteor is falling to Earth soon and you spend your last minutes on the rooftop with your closest person. 

[From [url=https://ahoegang.itch.io/like-its-our-last]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一颗陨石即将坠向地球，你与最亲近的人在屋顶上，共度最后的几分钟。

[摘自[url=https://ahoegang.itch.io/like-its-our-last]itch.io[/url]]
